_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Brothers Return#000.src: Were it not for our teachings, I would not let you set even one singular toe upon this holy ground after what you did.

Brothers Return#001.src: Hey! Don't put that down there—

Brothers Return#002.src: If you could go to {p} and see if Drucksh has the will, I would be forever in your debt, pal.
Brothers Return#002.dst: Si pudieras ir a {p} y ver si Drucksh tiene el testamento, te lo debería de por vida, colega.

Brothers Return#004.src: There must be something around here that could make him talk...
Brothers Return#004.dst: Por aquí tiene que haber algo que le haga hablar...

Brothers Return#005.src: You may have forgotten already, but I unfortunately must inform you that your brother is indeed dead.
Brothers Return#005.dst: Puede que ya lo hayas olvidado, pero, por desgracia, debo informarte de que tu hermano está, en efecto, muerto.

Brothers Return#006.src: As I already told you, your brother is dead and buried. It's not like—
Brothers Return#006.dst: Como ya te he dicho, tu hermano está muerto y enterrado. No es que—

Brothers Return#007.src: They've what!? Holy Bovine! It's even worse than I feared!
Brothers Return#007.dst: ¿¡Que han qué!? ¡Santa Vaca! ¡Es aún peor de lo que temía!

Brothers Return#010.src: You find the will tucked into an inner pocket of Sayleros' brother's crumbling tunic.
Brothers Return#010.dst: Encuentras el testamento metido en un bolsillo interior de la túnica raída del hermano de Sayleros.

Brothers Return#012.src: The exit seems to be opening...
Brothers Return#012.dst: Parece que la salida se está abriendo...

Brothers Return#014.src: Please, take these as proof of my gratitude, pal. You really helped us out, in more ways than one.
Brothers Return#014.dst: Toma esto como prueba de mi gratitud, colega. Nos has ayudado muchísimo, y de más de una forma.

Brothers Return#015.src: The obelisk does not react to your touch. [Req: {p} Trouble]
Brothers Return#015.dst: El obelisco no reacciona a tu tacto. [Requiere: Problemas en {p}]

Brothers Return#017.src: Hey! Don't put that down there
Brothers Return#017.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#018.src: Oh, hello there, adventurer! I was just looking for someone like you! My name is Sayleros. I lived in {p} my whole life, but recently decided to move to {p}.
Brothers Return#018.dst: ¡Ah, hola, aventurero! ¡Justo buscaba a alguien como tú! Me llamo Sayleros. He vivido toda mi vida en {p}, pero hace poco decidí mudarme a {p}.
Brothers Return#018.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#019.src: You see, my older brother just passed. I would have taken care of it, if only I weren't so busy with the move!
Brothers Return#019.dst: Verás, mi hermano mayor acaba de morir. Yo me habría encargado de todo, ¡si no anduviera tan liado con la mudanza!
Brothers Return#019.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#020.src: I had to leave it all to my younger brother, Drucksh. He's still in {p}, but well, he's not the most reliable...
Brothers Return#020.dst: Tuve que dejárselo todo a mi hermano pequeño, Drucksh. Sigue en {p}, pero bueno, no es que sea muy de fiar...
Brothers Return#020.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#021.src: My older brother had amassed quite some wealth before he passed. He should have left us part of it in his will, only I don't exactly trust Drucksh to handle it...
Brothers Return#021.dst: Mi hermano mayor reunió bastante fortuna antes de morir. Debía dejarnos parte en su testamento, pero no me fío de que Drucksh lo gestione...
Brothers Return#021.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#022.src: If you could go to {p} and see if Drucksh has the will, I would forever be in your debt, pal.
Brothers Return#022.dst: Si pudieras ir a {p} y ver si Drucksh tiene el testamento, te lo debería de por vida, colega.
Brothers Return#022.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#023.src: Drucksh shouldn't be hard to find, he usually spends his time in the bar in {p}. Just follow this road out of {p} to get there.
Brothers Return#023.dst: Drucksh no será difícil de encontrar, suele pasar el rato en el bar de {p}. Sigue este camino para salir de {p} y llegarás.
Brothers Return#023.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#024.src: Find Drucksh at the bar in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Brothers Return#024.dst: Encuentra a Drucksh en el bar de {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#025.src: Thanks again for doing this, pal. Just follow this road out of {p} to get to {p}, Drucksh's usually at the bar there.
Brothers Return#025.dst: Gracias otra vez por esto, colega. Sigue este camino para salir de {p} y llegar a {p}; Drucksh suele estar en el bar de allí.
Brothers Return#025.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#028.src: Aauuughh... s-something... mmmmgh... to... drink... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#028.dst: Aauuughh... a-algo... mmmmgh... de... beber... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#028.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#029.src: Find a way to make Drucksh tell you about the will.
Brothers Return#029.dst: Encuentra la manera de que Drucksh te hable del testamento.

Brothers Return#030.src: Aauuughh... s-something... mmmmgh... to... drink... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#030.dst: Aauuughh... a-algo... mmmmgh... de... beber... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#030.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#032.src: Anythin' is possible. If ya have [{~} Emeralds] to spare, that is.
Brothers Return#032.dst: Todo es posible. Si te sobran [{~} esmeraldas], claro.
Brothers Return#032.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#033.src: One {p} Whiskey, shipwrecked against the rocks, comin' right up.
Brothers Return#033.dst: Un whisky de {p}, estrellado contra las rocas, marchando.
Brothers Return#033.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#034.src: Hey, Drucksh. Hey, can you hear me? Hey!
Brothers Return#034.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#036.src: This nice fella got ya a drink. A {p} Whiskey, yer favourite.
Brothers Return#036.dst: Este buen hombre te ha invitado a una copa. Un whisky de {p}, tu favorito.
Brothers Return#036.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#038.src: Hey! They paid for yer drink, ya know. Ya could at least try to be courteous.
Brothers Return#038.dst: ¡Eh! Te han pagado la copa, que lo sepas. Podrías ser un poco más cortés.
Brothers Return#038.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#039.src: Oh, s-shut up. I c-can pay for my own drinks!
Brothers Return#039.dst: Ay, c-cállate. ¡Yo me p-puedo pagar mis copas!
Brothers Return#039.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#040.src: Well, call me if ya need anythin' else.
Brothers Return#040.dst: Bueno, llámame si necesitas algo más.
Brothers Return#040.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#045.src: Yeah, there ain't no will, pal. After brother died, those Bovemists came and picked 'im up.
Brothers Return#045.dst: Ya, no hay ningún testamento, colega. Cuando mi hermano murió, vinieron esos Bovemist y se lo llevaron.
Brothers Return#045.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#046.src: Gave 'im a proper funeral and everything. Shame my dear, oh so dear brother couldn't attend. What kind of person can't be there for their own brother's funeral, y'know?
Brothers Return#046.dst: Le hicieron un funeral en condiciones y todo. Lástima que mi querido, ay, queridísimo hermano no pudiera asistir. ¿Qué clase de persona falta al funeral de su propio hermano?
Brothers Return#046.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#047.src: Well, I couldn't be there either, bein' here and all, but that's besides the point...
Brothers Return#047.dst: Bueno, yo tampoco pude ir, estando aquí y tal, pero eso es otra cosa...
Brothers Return#047.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#048.src: Anyway, the Bishop gave me a bit of money for my troubles and sent me on my merry way. Then, I ended up here, and haven't left since!
Brothers Return#048.dst: En fin, el obispo me dio algo de dinero por las molestias y me mandó a paseo. Acabé aquí y no me he movido desde entonces.
Brothers Return#048.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#049.src: So, as I already told you... There ain't no will, pal! Forget it.
Brothers Return#049.dst: Así que, como ya te he dicho... ¡No hay testamento, colega! Olvídalo.
Brothers Return#049.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#050.src: W-what? Sayleros told you about a will, a-and about money too, t-that brother left us?
Brothers Return#050.dst: ¿Q-qué? ¿Sayleros te habló de un testamento, y-y también de dinero que nos dejó mi hermano?
Brothers Return#050.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#051.src: So then why did the Bishop...
Brothers Return#051.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#053.src: S-stop! Hold your horses... That would mean...
Brothers Return#053.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#054.src: Hey, soldier! We're leaving, right now! W-we're gonna find that will!
Brothers Return#054.dst: ¡Eh, soldado! ¡Nos vamos, ahora mismo! ¡V-vamos a encontrar ese testamento!
Brothers Return#054.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#055.src: Speak to the Bishop Kaideus in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Brothers Return#055.dst: Habla con el obispo Kaideus en {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#056.src: Yes, yes. A little more to the right! Hurry!
Brothers Return#056.dst: Sí, sí. ¡Un poco más a la derecha! ¡Deprisa!
Brothers Return#056.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#057.src: Hey! Priest man, guy, whatever! Where's my brother!
Brothers Return#057.dst: ¡Eh! ¡Cura, tío, lo que seas! ¿¡Dónde está mi hermano!?
Brothers Return#057.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#058.src: Oh, it's you. For your information, the proper term of address is your excellency.
Brothers Return#058.dst: Ah, eres tú. Para tu información, el tratamiento correcto es su excelencia.
Brothers Return#058.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#059.src: You may have forgotten already, but I must inform you that your brother is indeed dead.
Brothers Return#059.dst: Puede que ya lo hayas olvidado, pero debo informarte de que tu hermano está, en efecto, muerto.
Brothers Return#059.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#060.src: Y-yes, I know all that, y-your priestliness. But where's my brother? I want to see 'im.
Brothers Return#060.dst: S-sí, todo eso ya lo sé, su reverendísima. ¿Pero dónde está mi hermano? Quiero verlo.
Brothers Return#060.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#061.src: You! Talk some sense into your, um, friend here. We buried his brother in the crypt here some time ago.
Brothers Return#061.dst: ¡Tú! Haz entrar en razón a tu, ejem, amigo. Enterramos a su hermano en la cripta hace ya tiempo.
Brothers Return#061.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#062.src: Now, please leave this peaceful house of worship, you're causing a ruckus. I have some quite important business to attend to, you see.
Brothers Return#062.dst: Ahora, haced el favor de salir de esta pacífica casa de oración, estáis armando alboroto. Tengo asuntos muy importantes que atender.
Brothers Return#062.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#063.src: Hey! I'm not leaving without my brother! No way, pal!
Brothers Return#063.dst: ¡Eh! ¡No me voy sin mi hermano! ¡Ni hablar, colega!
Brothers Return#063.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#064.src: As I already told you, your brother is dead and buried. It's not like
Brothers Return#064.dst: Como ya te he dicho, tu hermano está muerto y enterrado. No es que
Brothers Return#064.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#066.src: Holy Bovine! It's even worse than I feared!
Brothers Return#066.dst: ¡Santa Vaca! ¡Es aún peor de lo que temía!
Brothers Return#066.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#067.src: You, soldier! You better not stick your nose in this! It's not for the likes of you to mess with the affairs of the church!
Brothers Return#067.dst: ¡Tú, soldado! ¡Más te vale no meter las narices en esto! ¡Los de tu clase no tenéis nada que hacer en los asuntos de la iglesia!
Brothers Return#067.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#068.src: Now's our chance, pal! Go find my brother in the crypts! I-I'll stay behind, guarding the rear!
Brothers Return#068.dst: ¡Es nuestra oportunidad, colega! ¡Ve a buscar a mi hermano a las criptas! ¡Y-yo me quedo aquí, cubriendo la retaguardia!
Brothers Return#068.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#069.src: Enter the crypt at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find Sayleros' Brother.
Brothers Return#069.dst: Entra en la cripta en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y encuentra al hermano de Sayleros.

Brothers Return#070.src: Now's our chance, pal! Go find my brother in the crypts! I-I'll stay behind, guarding the rear!
Brothers Return#070.dst: ¡Es nuestra oportunidad, colega! ¡Ve a buscar a mi hermano a las criptas! ¡Y-yo me quedo aquí, cubriendo la retaguardia!
Brothers Return#070.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#071.src: You better not stick your nose in this, soldier! It's not for the likes of you to mess with the affairs of the church!
Brothers Return#071.dst: ¡No metas las narices en esto, soldado! ¡Los asuntos de la iglesia no son para los de tu clase!
Brothers Return#071.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#072.src: Don't ask me about anything! I just work here!
Brothers Return#072.dst: ¡A mí no me preguntes nada! ¡Yo solo trabajo aquí!
Brothers Return#072.speaker: Worker

Brothers Return#074.dst: Encuentra la primera llave de la cripta.

Brothers Return#075.src: Open the door at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] using the Crypt Basement Key.
Brothers Return#075.dst: Abre la puerta en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] con la Crypt Basement Key.

Brothers Return#076.dst: Encuentra la segunda llave de la cripta.

Brothers Return#077.src: Open the door at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] using the Sealed Crypt Key.
Brothers Return#077.dst: Abre la puerta en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] con la Sealed Crypt Key.

Brothers Return#078.dst: Entra en la cripta sellada en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#080.dst: Sal de la cripta sellada en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#081.src: Bring back Sayleros' brother's will to [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Brothers Return#081.dst: Lleva el testamento del hermano de Sayleros a [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#082.src: As I've already told you a thousand times, I don't know what will you're talking about! Besides, I don't have the time for this!
Brothers Return#082.dst: ¡Como ya te he dicho mil veces, no sé de qué testamento hablas! ¡Además, no tengo tiempo para esto!
Brothers Return#082.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#084.src: I certainly hope you didn't use the usual methods of your sort...
Brothers Return#084.dst: Espero de veras que no hayas usado los métodos habituales de los tuyos...
Brothers Return#084.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#085.src: ... B-brother! What are y-you doing here?
Brothers Return#085.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#086.src: Drucksh! Likewise, what are you doing here?
Brothers Return#086.dst: ¡Drucksh! Lo mismo digo, ¿qué haces tú aquí?
Brothers Return#086.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#087.src: W-well... I-I thought I'd take responsibility for our family for once...
Brothers Return#087.dst: P-pues... S-se me ocurrió dar la cara por la familia por una vez...
Brothers Return#087.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#088.src: I thought I wouldn't live to see the day! Here I was, worried Drucksh wouldn't cooperate, but it seems like the two of you've got it all under control after all.
Brothers Return#088.dst: ¡Creí que no viviría para verlo! Y yo preocupado por si Drucksh no colaboraba, y resulta que lo teníais todo controlado.
Brothers Return#088.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#089.src: Under control!? This... This... renegade stormed into the crypts and k-k-killed your brother!
Brothers Return#089.dst: ¿¡Controlado!? Este... Este... ¡este renegado irrumpió en las criptas y m-m-mató a tu hermano!
Brothers Return#089.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#090.src: He's our brother, your priestliness! Let us w-worry about 'im and you can worry about your great cow in the sky, or whatever it is.
Brothers Return#090.dst: ¡Es NUESTRO hermano, su reverendísima! De él nos p-preocupamos nosotros, y tú preocúpate de tu vaca celestial o lo que sea.
Brothers Return#090.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#091.src: That's right, your priestliness! Here, I'll take the will.
Brothers Return#091.dst: ¡Eso es, su reverendísima! Venga, yo me quedo el testamento.
Brothers Return#091.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#092.src: Hey, brother, why don't we head to the ol' watering hole. For old brother's sake.
Brothers Return#092.dst: Oye, hermano, ¿nos pasamos por el garito de siempre? Por él.
Brothers Return#092.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#093.src: Well, i-if it's for his sake, then I c-can hardly refuse, can I?
Brothers Return#093.dst: B-bueno, s-si es por él, no me puedo negar, ¿verdad?
Brothers Return#093.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#094.src: Please, take this as proof of my gratitude, pal. You really helped us out, in more ways than one.
Brothers Return#094.dst: Toma esto como prueba de mi gratitud, colega. Nos has ayudado muchísimo, y de más de una forma.
Brothers Return#094.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#095.src: Hey soldier! That's quite the gear you're lugging around. Anything I can do for you?
Brothers Return#095.dst: ¡Eh, soldado! Menudo equipo llevas encima. ¿Puedo hacer algo por ti?
Brothers Return#095.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#096.src: Oh, really? I don't think I've seen you before, but I'm not so good with faces, especially armoured ones! I'm new to Wynn, just came through on the caravan. The name's Alfe, and yours?
Brothers Return#096.dst: ¿Ah, sí? No creo haberte visto antes, ¡aunque no se me dan bien las caras, menos aún las acorazadas! Soy nueva en Wynn, acabo de llegar en la caravana. Me llamo Alfe, ¿y tú?
Brothers Return#096.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#097.src: {u}, huh? I think I've heard of you somewhere... Laen was regaling stories at the {p} bar, you helped them find some old book, yeah? And I think the Bishop mentioned...
Brothers Return#097.dst: {u}, ¿eh? Creo que te he oído nombrar... Laen contaba historias en el bar de {p}: les ayudaste a encontrar un libro viejo, ¿no? Y creo que el obispo mencionó...
Brothers Return#097.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#098.src: You! Back again to cause more mayhem, are we?
Brothers Return#098.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#099.src: No need to be so hostile, your excellency! We were just discussing our time here in Wynn. {u} here even helped Laen find an old book of theirs, did you know that?
Brothers Return#099.dst: ¡No hace falta tanta hostilidad, su excelencia! Solo hablábamos de nuestro tiempo aquí en Wynn. {u} incluso ayudó a Laen a encontrar un libro viejo suyo, ¿lo sabía?
Brothers Return#099.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#100.src: Hm... Well, you certainly are not, my young apprentice. That much is true...
Brothers Return#100.dst: Hm... Bueno, tú desde luego no lo eres, mi joven aprendiz. Eso es cierto...
Brothers Return#100.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#101.src: Right, {u}! We could really use your help here, isn't that right Kaideus?
Brothers Return#101.dst: ¡Eso, {u}! Nos vendría muy bien tu ayuda aquí, ¿verdad, Kaideus?
Brothers Return#101.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#102.src: Another pair of hands on the task wouldn't hurt, you are right about that...
Brothers Return#102.dst: Un par de manos más no vendría mal, en eso tienes razón...
Brothers Return#102.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#103.src: Fine! You may inspect the texts, but only if you are very, very careful.
Brothers Return#103.dst: ¡Está bien! Puedes examinar los textos, pero solo si eres muy, muy cuidadoso.
Brothers Return#103.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#104.src: Well, you see {u}! I've been in {p} for the past little while helping to protect the city. But after Kaideus here stumbled across a shelf of old records I came here to help sort and clean them.
Brothers Return#104.dst: ¡Verás, {u}! He pasado una temporada en {p} ayudando a proteger la ciudad. Pero cuando Kaideus encontró por casualidad un estante de registros antiguos, vine a ayudar a ordenarlos y limpiarlos.
Brothers Return#104.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#105.src: They're positively ancient! It's all nonsense to me, but Laen says they must be over a thousand years old!
Brothers Return#105.dst: ¡Son antiquísimos! Para mí no son más que garabatos, ¡pero Laen dice que tienen más de mil años!
Brothers Return#105.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#106.src: You recruits are much to excitable, but she is right. Having dedicated my life to this cathedral, I have not been afforded the opportunity to see much of the world beyond these plains.
Brothers Return#106.dst: Los reclutas sois demasiado entusiastas, pero ella tiene razón. Habiendo dedicado mi vida a esta catedral, no he tenido ocasión de ver mucho mundo más allá de estas llanuras.
Brothers Return#106.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#107.src: So, {u}, why don't you take a look? You've traveled quite a bit, perhaps even to the lands described within. I may not like your methods, but perhaps, just this once, they may prove useful.
Brothers Return#107.dst: Así que, {u}, ¿por qué no les echas un vistazo? Has viajado bastante, quizá incluso a las tierras que ahí se describen. No me gustan tus métodos, pero tal vez, por esta vez, resulten útiles.
Brothers Return#107.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#108.src: Well then, what would you like to read?
Brothers Return#108.speaker: Alfe
